title: New: animated BorderBeam component (antd v6.4+)
body: Major surfaces on the home page now feature the new antd BorderBeam effect, which traces a moving highlight around a container. Used here to draw attention to the announcements grid.

title: Breaking: static message API replaced with App.useApp()
body: All static message.* calls now resolve through the active ConfigProvider. Make sure your custom antd setup wraps the tree in <App> so messages inherit the current theme tokens.

title: Security: weekly dependency refresh
body: Bumped antd to 6.6.2 and aligned related ecosystem packages to their latest 6.x releases. No action required for consumers; please re-run pnpm install to sync your lockfile.

title: Heads up: mock data is now locked on
body: The data-mode toggle in the header has been removed. The app ships with mocks enabled by default until the live API is generally available. This avoids accidental data fetches against an empty backend.
